segments.line: He walked home at sunset, and his shadow stretched long and calm behind him.
That night, his shadow flinched back from the dark alley. He didn't even notice.
His shadow pointed at the wet floor sign. He walked right past it — and slipped.
His shadow pointed at the stranger's smiling face. He believed him anyway.
His shadow waved for his attention as he walked toward the exit.
At the crosswalk, his shadow planted its feet and pulled back hard.
The shadow yanked him back by the arm — just as a car rushed past.
In the dark, he finally understood. His shadow gave a small nod.
And at sunset, they walked together into the orange light — side by side.
